purpose: CONNECTIVITY TEST — proves ChatGPT can read this repo and push assets back. Not wired to any channel renderer.

requests.prompt: A single glowing orange funnel on a pure black background, minimal line-art style, thick clean strokes, centered, no text anywhere in the image.
requests.style: minimal line art, orange on black, high contrast
requests.notes: Vertical 9:16. No text, no watermarks, no logos.

requests.prompt: The same orange funnel, with a single droplet falling through it from top to bottom over the course of the clip.
requests.style: minimal line art, orange on black, high contrast
requests.notes: PREFERRED PATH: deliver 24 numbered PNG frames — we compose them into video with ffmpeg on our side. Only use gif/mp4 if you can genuinely produce them. If you can produce NEITHER frames NOR a video file, say so explicitly in the drop manifest with status 'unsupported' — a truthful 'I cannot' is a passing test result.
